description: This file defines the EventLoopGroup class, which manages one or more event loops for I/O and background tasks within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It provides mechanisms to configure and instantiate event loop groups, typically used in network or asynchronous operations.

classes.name: EventLoopGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of event loops (one per thread) used for I/O and background tasks in the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It allows configuration of the number of threads and manages the lifecycle of the underlying event loops.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns default configuration options for the EventLoopGroup, specifically setting 'max_threads' to 0.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new EventLoopGroup instance with optional configuration, creating underlying native resources and setting the maximum number of threads.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native event loop group resources when the PHP object is destroyed.
